description: This file defines the PlaceholderingRenderCache class, which extends RenderCache to add automatic placeholdering for cacheable render elements in Drupal. It manages caching of placeholder results and overrides get/set methods to optimize rendering performance for lazy-loaded elements.

classes.name: PlaceholderingRenderCache
classes.description: A cache class that automatically replaces certain render elements with placeholders to improve cacheability and rendering performance in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PlaceholderingRenderCache with dependencies including request stack, cache factory, cache contexts manager, and placeholder generator.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached render element, creating and returning a placeholder if applicable.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a render element in cache, replacing it with a placeholder if conditions are met.

methods.name: createPlaceholderAndRemember
methods.description: Creates a placeholder for a renderable array and stores the original in a static cache.

methods.name: getFromPlaceholderResultsCache
methods.description: Retrieves a previously stored placeholder result from the static cache.
